gaps.title: Completion-definition gap
gaps.problem: Institutional, observational, technological, and physical endpoints are conflated.
gaps.research_need: Use a multi-layer completion taxonomy and evidence-state labels.

gaps.title: Coupled-reachability gap
gaps.problem: Nuclear stability and technology/evidence feasibility lack a common uncertainty-aware decision object.
gaps.research_need: Model physical stability, production/detection feasibility, and uncertainty jointly but distinctly.

gaps.title: Proof-chain gap
gaps.problem: New methods require a transparent path from an observation to an identity/priority claim.
gaps.research_need: Encode evidence obligations independently of a particular instrument generation.

gaps.title: Forecast-validation gap
gaps.problem: Conditional reachability forecasts need historical calibration rather than narrative plausibility.
gaps.research_need: Benchmark prospectively declared forecasts on a time-sliced historical corpus.
